nl: 用 antd 风格做资源管理：查询资源名称；表格展示资源名称、资源类型；资源是树形结构，默认全部展开；支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Resource management with an Ant Design look: query by resource name; the table shows resource name and resource type; resources are hierarchical and all nodes start expanded; supports add, edit and delete.
notes: AI-09 子项③: 声明式树表（antdv/SFC）
